🐝 Don’t bumble through the real estate market—let a pro help you find your hive. #realestateexpert 

Whether you’re buying, selling, or just buzzing with questions, I’ll help you navigate every step with confidence. 🏡
From finding the perfect home to negotiating the best deal, I’m here to make your real estate journey smooth and sweet—no stings attached.

📍 Serving Central Texas, including Killeen, Temple, Belton, and surrounding areas.
📲 Call or text today and let’s get you moving in the right direction.
Contact Bill Vernon, Realtor®, today -

📩 Bill@i35group.com

i35 Group is a group of hard-working real estate agents always striving to get the best deal for our buyers and the most money for our sellers. We are neighborhood experts in Central Texas. Choose us for your real estate needs.
